action.mutates: six TCP logins to 127.0.0.1:3306; as p8test_mrw creates and drops the database p8test_mrwdb, as p8test_mro one refused CREATE DATABASE; the server records them in its data directory (/var/lib/mysql: system tables, logs); the answers go to /run/p8test-mariadb/answers.txt
installs mariadb-client-core on the peer if absent; makes three TCP logins from the peer to the class node's port 3306; the answers go to /run/p8test-mariadb-peer/answers.txt
